new_source_finding.finding: VoicePacketCortex.close_session only requires that at least one output be fully heard/commit-eligible before accepting a caller-supplied VoiceOutcome result_ref/result_sha256. VoiceOutcome itself is explicitly identity/provenance-only and validates the result pair structurally but does not prove it is the heard output payload. Existing tests intentionally use synthetic fixed result digests after a completed output. Therefore the new state/memory/context consumer must add an exact heard-output/result binding fence rather than treating VoiceOutcome.result_ref as semantic truth.

required_constraints: VSR01/VSR02 selected ContextItems require exact ContextCostWitness binding.
VoiceOutcome result promotion requires exact binding to the ordered fully heard output payload/aggregate.
Interrupted heard-prefix remains a separate ephemeral payload with its own digest and ContextCostWitness; no durable VoiceOutcome result/memory/effect authority.
Opaque gwt_ref/memory_refs/tool_ref remain non-authoritative until exact existing F2 authority bindings succeed.
ASR008 remains frozen against new dispatch until existing workflow/run set is reconciled.
decision.next_exact_action: Trigger4 refreshes overlap for the existing T7 cortex integration boundary, implements only the smallest external adapter/harness needed to bind exact heard-output payload -> VoiceOutcome -> ContextCostWitness/TypedMemory/GWT references, executes VSR01-VSR06 plus the new arbitrary-result and multi-segment-order negatives on the proven VPS route, and promotes only measured component-integration scope. Trigger7 must not reopen WP704/WP715 or create another ASR008 dispatch.
